summary: SearXNG is an open-source internet metasearch engine that combines queries from multiple external search services and databases into a single interface. As a fork of Searx, it aims to provide aggregated search results while routing requests through a self-hosted instance to improve privacy.
goodFor: It is a good fit if you want to eliminate third-party tracking from your web searches by routing your queries through your own infrastructure.
watchOut: You may face reliability issues when upstream search services change their scraping protections, which can break specific result fetchers until updates are applied.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically handled via Docker containers, and you will usually need to configure a reverse proxy in front of the application to handle TLS termination.
